name: budget-weekly-dataflow-guard
purpose: Keep stage Java weekly changes from drifting into the live budget editing UI, permission, and save path.
policy: Budget UI and edit path must remain live-identical unless a budget-scoped change is explicitly approved.
Java weekly/stage changes are limited to weekly expense input, cashflow read model, and auth/session routes.
Weekly expense input must not hydrate, aggregate, or force-refresh cashflow read models.
Projection/Actual comparison UI belongs in /portal/cashflow only.

nodes.role: Budget codebook, budget plan, budget tree persistence boundary
Budget codebook save and rename propagation
Weekly expense input, save, and navigation only
Projection/Actual read model and comparison UI

allowedEdges.reason: Budget UI calls budget-scoped store actions.
Budget codebook is saved through the live budget document path.
Budget rename propagates to budget plan rows through the live path.
Budget rename propagation stays live-compatible and does not call the weekly Java draft save.
Evidence-required mapping follows budget rename changes.
Weekly expense input owns row input/save/navigation only.
Weekly draft save can use Java authority in platform API mode.
Cashflow reads Projection/Actual through the read model channel.

forbiddenEdges.reason: Budget editing must not route through weekly Java draft save.
Java weekly changes are out of budget edit scope.
Weekly expense screen can navigate to cashflow but must not render Projection/Actual comparison UI.
